lines.text: Have you ever seen a cloud
Puffy was the smallest cloud in the sky.
While big clouds poured happy silver showers,
no matter how hard Puffy tried,
it couldn't make a single raindrop!
Down below, the lush garden felt warm and dry.
One day, Puffy spotted a tiny sunflower
whose yellow petals drooped over cracked dry soil.
and squeezed tightly to try one more time.
Tiny glowing drops became a gentle shower!
Crystal raindrops danced onto the thirsty leaves.
The little sunflower bloomed tall and bright again!
Puffy cheered, finally discovering its special power.
Remember, even the smallest among us
can make a BIG difference! Subscribe to Kidolu!
